name: Cavaliere Berlinetta
original_name: カヴァリエーレ・ベルリネッタ
source:
Childhood friend of Testarossa and her personal bodyguard. She is cool and articulate and is quite militaristic in her behavior.

She is intelligent and is fluent in Japanese. She has no interest in Takurou because she is a lesbian. She is secretly in love with Testarossa but doesn't dare to reveal her feelings.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/saimin/]Official site[/url]]
